lines: Now that we've split into new classes, let's see what everyone's strengths are in this combat simulation first.
It was time for practical training. Sakura-sensei had brought us to the underground training complex.
Here you could conduct realistic combat exercises via simulations. It was so large that it could completely fit a certain baseball dome.
There was a device equipped to project 3D imagery throughout the entire room. It could reproduce natural phenomena such as rain, snow, and wind, temperature, gravity, and even smell.
Although the training complex could be called a "pseudo five-sense-theater" for Taimanin, it was actually dangerous, in that you could be wounded in combat or even die if you were unlucky.
...While some people were simply delighted about getting to use it.
You look happy, even though we just fought those snakes and bears a few minutes ago.
Because I don't get to use this place very often. It's been a long time.
You don't get to use it often? Why?
When we playtested the simulator, I went a little overboard and blew out all the electronics. I guess that's why.
Come to think of it, the construction was suddenly extended when this place was almost finished. So that was your fault.
Why are you looking at me like that? Thanks to me, they reevaluated the strength of this thing and made it more robust. You should be thanking me.
I guess that's one way to spin it. But you really are breaking things all the time. I've heard rumors.
Shut up. It's not like I break stuff because I want to break stuff.
You over there, stop the talking. Ah, Fuma-kun and Yukikaze-chan again? What are we gonna do with you... just listen properly please.
We fell silent as Sakura-sensei glared at us.
Someone seems to want to go wild right away, so I'm going to start the simulator. Here we go♪
The scenery around us changed instantly.
We were in the entertainment district of a city somewhere, and it was night.
The neon lights glittering in the darkness were tough on our eyes.
It was a situation unsuitable for combat.
Listen here. This is the location and it's night. The enemies are demons.
You're going to form teams of four and teams will take turns battling. And this is how the teams look.
The teams were displayed on a monitor.
(Looks like I'm teaming up with Hebiko, Shikanosuke, and... hey, hey...)
What? I'm teaming up with Fuma again?
You took the words out of my mouth.
I'm happy that I'm with Hebiko-chan. Her octopus tentacles are cute.
Thank you. Hebiko is happy too, because it's fun to watch Yukikaze-chan's sparky sparks.
The leader is the person whose name is at the top. The other three must follow the leader's orders. That is absolute. Got it?
The other teams were also in a commotion.
Sakura-sensei! Am I going to work under Fuma's command too? Even though he's all talk?
That's right. I had noticed for a while, Yukikaze-chan, but you act too much on your own. You shouldn't do that.
Fuma-kun, make sure to properly give orders to Yukikaze-chan. No telling her, "just act on your own"!
Damn, Sakura-sensei had beaten me to the punch.
Alright, you're allowed to discuss within your teams for a while. After that, we'll start with the first team.
The students gathered in their teams and began their prep meetings.
So, what do we do? You got a plan or whatever?
Yukikaze turned on me with a face dripping with discontent.
How would there be a plan if we don't even know what kind of enemy we'll be up against. For now I'm going to teach you the hand signals I always use, so memorize those.
That thing you were doing, fiddling around with your fingers? Can't you just say it with your mouth? I hate stuff like that because it's so tedious.
It's faster than talking. The enemy won't know what we're up to and you only need to memorize the simple ones.
Ughhh, alright. Then hurry up already and explain it to me, chop-chop.
Why are you talking down to me?
I didn't really feel like it, but I started teaching Yukikaze the hand signals.
Whoa, every little detail. Are you always giving orders about minor stuff like that? It's so tedious.
She complained right off the bat, but after 10 minutes...
Ummm, first Shikanosuke distracts the enemy with his radio waves. Then Hebiko-chan cuts in from the side and shoots her ink...
And finally I'm going to do a lightning strike from behind?
N-No way. You mastered Fuma's convoluted hand signals in such a short time? That's amazing.
It kind of pisses me off seeing you surprised in that way. Do you think I'm stupid, Fuma?
But with this, we would at least somehow look like a team.
In the combat area, other teams had already begun the training, but one after another they were being judged as "defeated."
What's this~? Did I make the enemy setting a little too strong? I thought this would be fine.
So far everyone's been wiped out? In over our heads, huh. Alright, the next team is... Oh, it's Fuma-kun and his team. Do your best!
H-Hey, they all got wiped out...?
Hmhmm, guess they're worthy opponents, huh. Then you'd better command us properly, Fuma!
